question: Under --backend sabre, are RDTSC/RDTSCP virtualized deterministically?

results.ptrace_rustbin_rdtsc: L2 PASS (both rdtsc AND rdtscp virtualized, magnitude 0x18867251ee..., deterministic)
results.sabre_rustbin_rdtsc: FAIL nondeterministic: rdtsc lines identical run1/run2 (virtualized 0x18867251ee...); rdtscp lines diverge (raw host TSC 0x27ac.../0x27b2..., changes every run)

root_cause: SaBRe backend does not intercept RDTSCP (opcode 0F 01 F9). SaBRe x86_64 rewriter (reverie third-party/sabre/arch/x86_64/rewriter.c) only detects 0x0F05 (SYSCALL) and 0x0F31 (RDTSC) (lines 117-119, 883); SIGILL fallback (loader/loader.c:102) recognizes only 0x0B0F (RDTSC). reverie-sabre Tool trait exposes only `fn rdtsc(&self)->u64` with FFI `handle_rdtsc_fn`; there is no rdtscp hook, handler, or FFI type anywhere in reverie-sabre. RDTSCP therefore is never rewritten/trapped and executes natively, leaking the raw host TSC (nondeterministic). The ptrace backend handles both via CR4.TSD faulting -> reverie-ptrace task.rs Rdtsc::Tsc/Tscp -> handle_rdtscs (sets rcx aux for Tscp).
fix_scope: Pinned reverie/SaBRe dependency (rrnewton/reverie). (1) third-party/sabre/arch/x86_64/rewriter.c: detect 3-byte RDTSCP 0F 01 F9 + add rdtscp_entrypoint (must preserve/set ECX = IA32_TSC_AUX); also SIGILL fallback in loader.c. (2) reverie-sabre: add ffi::handle_rdtscp_fn, wire rdtscp_handler in internal.rs/premain.c, add Tool::rdtscp() -> (tsc, aux). (3) detcore-sabre/src/lib.rs: implement rdtscp() hook -> coordinator virtual TSC + deterministic aux (detcore already virtualizes getcpu, aux=0).
fix_status: NOT landed. Requires approval + reverie feature branch + pin bump (interception-semantics change to a core Reverie/SaBRe contract, per parent Reverie API Policy). Same disposition bucket as sabre pipe EAGAIN (#1035) and RT-signal reverie#207.
in_hermit_mitigation: None that makes rustbin_rdtsc deterministic. Masking the RDTSCP CPUID feature bit (CPUID 80000001H:EDX[27]) via hermit's CPUID virtualization would steer well-behaved programs to rdtsc+lfence, but rustbin_rdtsc/__rdtscp call it unconditionally regardless of the bit, and it would affect all backends. Not a fix.
